## Verdict

Lumen Path costs least for a team of 30, at $270 per month. All three minimums fall below the team size, so every vendor bills for exactly 30 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly. Estuary is $420 and Gable is $630.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the larger of 30 and the vendor minimum. Every minimum here (1, 10, 25) is below 30, so no vendor forces payment for unused seats.

- **Gable:** 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**.
- **Lumen Path:** 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**.
- **Estuary:** 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**.

Lumen Path is $150 per month cheaper than Estuary and $360 per month cheaper than Gable — $1,800 and $4,320 over twelve months. The spread between cheapest and dearest is $360 per month.

## Risks

This is the rare case where minimums do nothing, so the comparison is a clean rate comparison and the ranking holds at every size above 25. Below that it shifts: under 25 people Estuary's floor bills $350 regardless, and under 10 people Lumen Path bills $90. Gable's 1-seat minimum makes it the only option with no floor at all, which matters if headcount drops sharply — at 4 seats or fewer Gable undercuts Lumen Path's $90 minimum.

Price is the only axis measured here. The list gives rates and minimums and nothing else, so feature coverage, support tiers, security posture and usage limits are unknown; Gable's rate is more than double Lumen Path's, and that gap may buy something the list does not mention.

Annual commitments, volume discounts and onboarding fees are not on the price list. All figures assume monthly billing as stated and may move at renewal.
